# Key wrapper v1 fixture

`registry.json` and `vectors.json` are byte-identical to
`contracts/key-wrapper/v1/` in `Palladin-io/palladin-protocol` at commit
`dadcd0f3649178531f8c102ea041b3aa006c721f` (palladin-protocol PR #18).

SHA-256:
- `registry.json`: `511890576c74b1f78439e10838c4e074a80186179f9ca17f98fb754a84fa223e`
- `vectors.json`: `c5a3fa98287def283527d15407d6aa44fd034af7a6014785637df1e697c9b83a`

The vectors were generated by the protocol reference implementation, which
uses `@noble/post-quantum` and libsodium independently of this client. All
keys, identifiers and wrapped keys are synthetic public test material. Update
the protocol fixture first, then vendor the same bytes here.
